mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 10.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 10.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad-based demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue visibility, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.04 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100.0 signals manufacturing slowdown that compresses corporate margins through reduced output efficiency, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during manufacturing downturns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 258.0 signals accelerating price pressures that trigger preemptive Fed tightening, increasing equity discount rates and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 258.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer confidence and durable goods demand, boosting corporate revenue expectations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal severe labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending power, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.04 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100.0 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output capacity and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year windows.
